findings.issue: package-lock.json:10818 pins jsdom 16.7.0, which has no HTMLDialogElement.showModal or Escape-to-cancel, so the modal tests will throw.
findings.recommended_change: Stub showModal/close in src/setupTests.js, fire a 'cancel' event to test Escape, and guard showModal in production code.

findings.issue: Task 4 enables Donate in App.js:125 and commits to main with no feature flag, which breaks the line-41 gate if Pages deploys from main.
findings.recommended_change: Work on a feature branch or use a REACT_APP_DONATIONS flag, and set the Pages bindings before merging.

findings.issue: package.json has no "type" or engines field, so ESM .js route files imported by node:test may parse as CJS.
findings.recommended_change: Pin engines.node or move the handlers into .mjs files that the route files re-export, and add a RED check for SyntaxError.

findings.issue: A public €1 Checkout endpoint invites card testing; the Origin check is spoofable by any script (see the line-103 curl), and the WAF limit has no task or test.
findings.recommended_change: Make a Cloudflare rate limit and Stripe Radar rules release gates, consider a €3-5 minimum and/or Turnstile, and describe Origin as CSRF-only.

findings.issue: An exact single DONATION_ORIGIN returns 403 on Pages previews and on npm start (package.json:5 proxy, localhost:3000).
findings.recommended_change: Use separate Preview and Production DONATION_ORIGIN values or a config allowlist, normalise slashes, require https except loopback, and document the dev origin.

findings.issue: locale is validated and sent by the client, but the Stripe field list leaves it out, so Checkout's language can differ from the modal's.
findings.recommended_change: Send locale=de|en to Stripe and assert it in the fake-fetch test; optionally add submit_type=donate.

findings.issue: paid|pending|not_found treats expired and delayed-method (complete+unpaid) sessions as pending, even though line 36 enables dynamic methods.
findings.recommended_change: Map status+payment_status to paid|processing|expired|not_found and test each mapping.

findings.issue: Exporting only onRequestPost/onRequestGet means the 405 for OPTIONS or other methods can't be tested and isn't guaranteed.
findings.recommended_change: Export onRequest, switch on method, return 405 with Allow/no-store headers, and test it directly.

findings.issue: A stateless server can't 'reject requests while the browser is waiting'; line 48 assigns that guard to the client.
findings.recommended_change: Reword as a client ref lock (like busy at App.js:51), optionally with an Idempotency-Key.

findings.issue: session_id stays in the URL after return, and Pages has no _headers Referrer-Policy (only server.cjs:17 sets one).
findings.recommended_change: Call history.replaceState to '/' after the status check settles, test it, and add public/_headers with no-referrer.

findings.issue: The plan updates only App.js:25; App.js:22,27,31 don't name Stripe, Cloudflare Functions, the legal basis, or third-country transfers.
findings.recommended_change: Add a Stripe payments section and a Cloudflare note to /datenschutz, and assert in a test that it names Stripe.

findings.issue: App.js:125's aria-label and small text 'Demnächst verfügbar', plus pdf_to_markdown/README.md:48 and README.md:13-14, still say Donate is disabled.
findings.recommended_change: List these edits explicitly and assert the button name is exactly 'Donate'.

findings.issue: The static-Pages statement is in root README.md:16-18, not pdf_to_markdown/README.md.
findings.recommended_change: Correct the citation and confirm the real Pages deploy mode before documenting it.

findings.issue: The rule doesn't say which navigator.languages entry wins (e.g. ['en-US','de-DE']), and the tests cover single values only.
findings.recommended_change: Specify the precedence rule and add a test with a multi-entry array.
